name: AltoRewrite – AI Content Rewriter
author: The Really Useful App Company

sections.description:
No API key. No account. No setup. AltoRewrite runs the AI on our hosted service, so there is nothing to configure.

Select the paragraphs, headings or list items you want to change, choose a tone (Clearer, Simpler, More formal or Friendlier) and click Rewrite selected blocks. Each rewrite appears beside your own text in the AltoRewrite panel, block by block, for you to apply or discard. Nothing changes in your post until you apply a rewrite, and nothing reaches your site until you save or update the post.

Links are checked: a block whose rewrite would add, drop or change a link is left as you wrote it, and the panel says so. The AI is told to keep your facts, names and numbers, but read each rewrite before you apply it. It is for clearer writing for your readers, not for making text look different from its source.

Watch it work: a short demo on a test site, with an AI-generated voiceover.

  • No API key or third-party account. The AI runs on our service.
  • Works in the block editor (the AltoRewrite pen icon in the top bar) and in the classic editor (the AltoRewrite box beside the editor: select text, then click Rewrite selection).
  • Four tones, and you choose for each rewrite.
  • Apply or discard each block’s rewrite on its own, or apply them all at once.
  • Privacy-friendly: nothing is sent until you click rewrite. To write a rewrite we send the post title and the text you selected, with a site ID (a hash of your site URL) and the plugin version. The External services section below lists everything that is sent.
  • The free plan covers 10 rewrites a month, and one click on Rewrite is one rewrite however many blocks you selected. AltoRewrite Pro raises that limit to 500 rewrites a month.

External services

This plugin connects to the Really Useful App Company API to write rewrites. It is required
for the plugin’s core feature.

  • What is sent and when: the plugin sends the post title and the text you selected to the API on
    this action, and nothing else triggers a send of your content:

    • when you click “Rewrite selected blocks” or “Rewrite selection” in the editor
  • Also sent: a site ID (a hash of your site URL) for usage counting, the chosen tone, and the
    plugin version, so we can tell which release a report relates to. We treat the site ID as personal data, because it can be matched to your site’s address. Our privacy policy explains how we use it. Whether this site’s review prompt was shown, snoozed, dismissed or clicked is also sent, so we can tell whether that prompt is working. It records the site, not the individual user, and says nothing about what you did on WordPress.org afterwards. If you choose to give us an email address, it is sent on its own, only when you submit your email address on the settings screen. It is optional, you are asked once (and again only after we have deleted it), and every feature keeps working if you skip or dismiss it. It is sent only if you tick the sign-up box, together with the wording you agreed to. We use it to send release notes and product updates and to give you a way to reach us. These emails are sent from our Microsoft 365 mailbox. You can unsubscribe from any message, and we delete it 24 months after your last contact with us. Whether this site’s email prompt was shown, dismissed or submitted is also sent, so we can tell whether it is working; it does not include the address itself.
  • Where it goes: the API (default https://api.thereallyusefulappcompany.com), which uses Anthropic as an AI
    subprocessor to generate the text.
  • Terms / privacy: https://www.thereallyusefulappcompany.com/altorewrite/terms , https://www.thereallyusefulappcompany.com/privacy#altorewrite ,
    https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Nothing is sent until you click “Rewrite selected blocks” or “Rewrite selection”. If you choose to give us an email address, it is sent when you submit it.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate AltoRewrite.
  2. Go to Settings → AltoRewrite and review the external-service notice.
  3. Edit a post, select the blocks or text you want to change, and open AltoRewrite: the pen icon at the top of the block editor, or the AltoRewrite box beside the classic editor.
  4. (Optional) Enter an AltoRewrite Pro licence key to raise the monthly limit.
sections.faq:
Do I need an AI API key?

No. The AI runs on our service.

Is anything changed without me seeing it?

No. Each rewrite waits in the AltoRewrite panel beside your own text until you apply it, and an applied rewrite reaches your site only when you save or update the post.

Which blocks can it rewrite?

Paragraphs, headings and list items, including those inside lists, quotes and groups. Images, tables and other blocks are left alone.

Does it keep my links and formatting?

It keeps links, bold, italics and inline code. A block whose rewrite would add, drop or change a link is left as you wrote it.

How much can I rewrite at once?

Up to 40 blocks, or about 6,000 characters of English (less for Chinese, Japanese and Korean, which take more of the limit per character). If a selection is too long, the panel asks you to select fewer blocks.

Does it send my content anywhere?

Only when you click rewrite, and only the post title and the text you selected. See the External services section.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • First release: rewrite selected blocks in the block editor or selected text in the classic editor, in one of four tones, and apply or discard each rewrite. Deleting the plugin removes everything it stored on your site.
